title: Five Weeks in a Balloon Or, Journeys and Discoveries in Africa by Three Englishmen
sourceTitle:
Five Weeks in a Balloon
Or, Journeys and Discoveries in Africa by Three Englishmen
author: Jules Verne
description: "Five Weeks in a Balloon" by Jules Verne is an adventure novel published in 1863.
longDescription: Dr. Samuel Fergusson, his manservant Joe, and professional hunter Richard Kennedy set out to cross unexplored Africa in a hydrogen balloon with a revolutionary altitude-control mechanism.

authorInfo.bio: Jules Verne (1828–1905) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Around the World in Eighty Days, A Journey to the Centre of the Earth, The Mysterious Island, From the Earth to the moon; and, round the moon. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
